exposure.910: Almost entirely text, code or data work (theoretical exposure, not unemployment risk)
exposure.78: Mostly cognitive or digital work (theoretical exposure, not unemployment risk)
exposure.56: A mix of AI-suitable and physical or interactive work
exposure.34: Mostly physical, interactive or situational work
exposure.12: Almost entirely physical or place-bound work
exposure.0: No credible effect on core tasks

adoption.910: Tools are documented as widely used in Finnish workplaces
adoption.78: Tools exist and use is material
adoption.56: Pilots and early use, not mainstream
